newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cbank sets 1-wk rev repo tender, 16 pct max.
newsitem.headline: Czech cbank sets 1-wk rev repo tender, 16 pct max.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) on Wednesday set a one-week reverse repo tender to drain market liquidity at a maximum rate of 16 percent, unchanged from a similar operation on Tuesday.
The CNB said in a statement that it would accept a maximum of two bids from each participant at a minimum of 100 million crowns per bid until 10.15 a.m. (0815 GMT).
Earlier on Thursday, average yield in the CNB's two-week reverse repo hit the maximum rate of 16 percent.
